title: The rooms of the house
description: Name the rooms of a house, and say where each one is.

explanation.summary: You know the kitchen, the bedroom and the bathroom. A house has more rooms than that, and they are the last of the house words you need at this level.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El salón, el recibidor, el sótano, el desván, el garaje y el pasillo are masculine. La sala, la azotea y el lavadero are feminine. La sala and el salón are often the same room in English, but la sala is the living room and el salón is the formal sitting room.

sections.heading: Where they are
sections.body: A house is a set of places, and estar says where each one is: el pasillo está en el medio, la azotea está encima de la cocina. En el medio and encima are the two you will use most in a house.

examples.es: el lavadero está en el fondo
examples.en: the utility room is at the end

examples.es: el pasillo está en el medio
examples.en: the hall is in the middle

examples.es: el sótano está debajo de la cocina
examples.en: the cellar is under the kitchen

exercises.prompt: Pair each word with its translation.
exercises.note: Every room is a noun with a gender, and estar says where it is.

exercises.prompt: Pick the Spanish word for “the living room”.

exercises.note: Masculine: el salón. It is the formal sitting room.

exercises.translation: the lounge has a big table

exercises.note: Masculine: el sótano. The accent marks the stress.

exercises.prompt: El ___ está debajo de la casa.
exercises.translation: the cellar is under the house
